facts.statement: Market makers quote continuous two-sided bid and ask prices, earning the bid-ask spread while dynamically managing inventory risk by hedging option delta in the underlying stock market.
Option buyers face strictly capped downside (100% of upfront premium) and post zero margin. Option writers face open-ended liabilities and must maintain margin accounts.
CBOE Naked Option Margin: Margin = Premium + max(20% of Spot - OTM Amount, 10% of Spot for calls / 10% of Strike for puts).

For a naked call writer with Stock S = $100, Strike K = $110 (OTM = $10), Premium = $4: Margin = $4 + max(0.20*$100 - $10, 0.10*$100) = $4 + max($10, $10) = $14 per share ($1,400 per 100-share contract).

The Options Clearing Corporation (OCC) acts as the central counterparty for all US exchange-traded options, performing novation, guaranteeing contract performance, and assigning exercise randomly to clearing members.
When an option holder exercises, the OCC assigns the exercise randomly or FIFO to a brokerage firm, which randomly assigns it to a customer with a short position in that series.

Warrants are call options issued directly by a corporation on its own stock. Unlike exchange-traded options, exercising a warrant creates new shares, diluting existing shareholders and bringing new cash into the firm.

Employee Stock Options (ESOs) are non-transferable call options granted by firms to employees to align executive incentives, typically featuring multi-year vesting periods and strike prices set at-the-money on grant date.
